struct segtree {

  void pull(int pos) {t[pos] = mret(t[pos*2], t[pos*2+1]);}
  void build(int v, int vl, int vr) {
    if (vl + 1 == vr) {
      t[v] = mret(vl);
      return;
    }
    int m = (vl + vr) / 2;
    build(v * 2, vl, m);
    build(v * 2 + 1, m, vr);
    pull(v);
  }
  void modify(int pos, int x, int v, int vl, int vr) {
    if (pos >= vl && pos < vr) {
      t[v] = mret(x, t[v]);
      return;
    }
    int m = (vl + vr) / 2;
    if (pos >= m){
      modify(pos, x, v*2+1, m, vr);
    }
    else {
      modify(pos, x, v*2, vl, m);
    }
    pull(v);
  }
   void modify(int pos, int x) {

    int m = (vl + vr) / 2;
    return mret(query(l, r, v * 2, vl, m), query(l, r, v * 2 + 1, m, vr));
  }
  int query(int l, int r){
